_note: An example business change session, invented to show the page: no real organisation.

meta.title: Moving support to the new ticketing system

impacts.change: Tickets move to the new system on 1 February.
impacts.need: Two weeks of practice on real tickets.

impacts.change: Customers get a new help form.
impacts.need: A clear notice and the old email still working for a month.

impacts.change: Weekly reports come from the new dashboards.
impacts.need: The same numbers they use today.

people.need: A frozen ticket backlog for the weekend

readiness.because: System set up, workflows half done.

risks.risk: Reports don’t match the old numbers.
risks.mitigation: Run both side by side for a month.

risks.risk: Agents fall back to the old inbox.
risks.mitigation: Switch the old inbox to read-only.

actions.what: Plan two weeks of training on real tickets.
